scope.claim: Determine only whether recursively generated NextN proxy states contain useful advance routing information on the exact drafted branch.
not_claimed: No cache, latency, byte-amplification, NVMe, serving-throughput, or online-prefetch qualification is made by this screen.
A PASS authorizes only a separately preregistered cost/cache/lead-time falsifier; it does not authorize online integration.
A FAIL stops this proxy branch before any cost or serving implementation.
scope.heldout_prohibited: No candidate-18 held-out, calibration, or test split artifact may be opened, mapped, named by case, or used.

open_split_proof.rule: Frequency counts use all and only train-fit selected_ids rows. Evaluation uses all and only the five listed train-precision cases. Any request overlap, unlisted request, digest mismatch, missing file, or different split metadata FAILS.

future_scorer.freeze_rule: The scorer, schema, tests, and mutation suite must be committed, tracked-clean at HEAD, hash-recorded in an execution manifest, and reviewed before trace implementation or any value capture. No scorer exists or is authorized at this plan-only candidate.

causal_protocol.source: For each listed prompt, tokenize the exact prompt bytes and set t to the final prompt-token position. Evaluate only that prompt through the normal target once to obtain pre-output-norm h_t in g->cur and q1=argmax(target logits after t). This source work precedes the measured candidate boundary and is identical in both phases.
candidate_process: Start a new process with only the exact prompt, h_t/q1 produced inside that process, model/tokenizer, MTP private KV, MTP weights, and non-expert target RMSNorm/router weights available. The target-route output path must not exist yet.

Set z_0=h_t, q_1=q1, min_pos=t. For j=1..8, call glm_graph_mtp_step with g->cur=z_(j-1), next_token=q_j, pos=t+j-1, min_pos=t. After its residual stage and before nextn_shared_head_norm, copy exact g->next into a dedicated z_j buffer. Its greedy head result is q_(j+1). Before the next call copy z_j byte-for-byte into g->cur; retain the same private MTP KV so slots t..t+j-1 form the causal window.

For every j and every target routed layer l=3..77, compute RMSNorm(z_j, layer[l].ffn_norm, DS4_RMS_EPS), then its 256-way ffn_gate_inp projection and ffn_exp_probs_b adjustment. Rank by adjusted score descending and expert ID ascending. Aggregate each expert over j=1..K by its maximum adjusted score, again tie-breaking by lower expert ID, and emit top budget IDs.

Write O_EXCL records containing case_id, prompt_sha256, source_position, source_prefix_token_sha256, j, q_j, absolute_position=t+j, layer, all adjusted scores, ranked IDs, stage ID, monotonic timestamps, MTP min/selected positions, and target-expert-dispatch count. Fsync files and directory, write their SHA-256 manifest, then exit successfully. The immutable candidate manifest must exist before Phase B begins.
target_process: Start a separate new process after candidate-process exit. Re-tokenize and re-evaluate the same bound prompt, require identical source prefix token hash, source position, q1, and model/tokenizer identities, then read the frozen q1..q8 sequence from the candidate manifest.

Evaluate exactly q1..q8 through all normal target layers and capture the actual eight selected expert IDs for each absolute position and each layer 3..77. Candidate records are read-only; target records are published separately with O_EXCL, fsync, and hashes.

The scorer requires byte-identical q1..q8 and exact position equality across the candidate manifest and target records, exactly one row for every case x j x layer, and strictly increasing j/positions. Any premature target artifact, shifted token/position, duplicate, reorder, missing layer, extra layer, or hash mismatch FAILS. Old retained target routes are prohibited because their recursive token-vector identity is not established.
causal_protocol.expert_prohibition: After the source_ready marker and through candidate manifest fsync, the normal routed-expert dispatch counter for layers 3..77 must remain exactly zero. Layer-78 NextN expert work is allowed and reported. Source-prefix target work is outside this interval.

baselines.frequency: For each layer, count selected_ids occurrences over all and only hash-bound train-fit rows; order by count descending then expert ID ascending. Use the fixed top budget for every K.
baselines.gate_replay: At source_ready, for each target layer apply that layer's RMSNorm/router/bias to the single h_t. Repeat the resulting per-layer ranking for j=1..K and aggregate with the same maximum-score and tie rules as the proxy.
baselines.isolation: Neither baseline may read train-precision selected_ids, Phase-B actual routes, candidate scores, or held-out artifacts while it is produced. Baseline records freeze in the candidate manifest before Phase B.

fixed_scorer_specification.sets: For each case, layer, K in {2,4,8}, and budget in {8,16}, true_union is the set union of the eight actual selected IDs at j=1..K; prediction is the first budget unique IDs in the frozen ranking. Duplicate predicted IDs FAIL.
fixed_scorer_specification.case_recall: For a fixed case/K/budget, sum |prediction intersect true_union| over exactly 75 layers and divide by the sum of |true_union| over those layers.
fixed_scorer_specification.macro: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the five case recalls.
fixed_scorer_specification.paired_difference: For each baseline separately, proxy case_recall minus baseline case_recall on the same case. Lower bound = mean(d) - 2.131846786326649 * sample_sd(d, denominator n-1) / sqrt(5). No clipping. If sample_sd is exactly zero, lower bound equals mean. Exactly n=5 is mandatory.
fixed_scorer_specification.absolute_lower_bound: Apply the same one-sided t formula to the five proxy case recalls.
fixed_scorer_specification.per_layer_recall: For each exact layer and primary K/budget, sum intersections across the five cases divided by the sum of true-union sizes across the five cases.
fixed_scorer_specification.failure_semantics: Any NaN, Inf, missing value/file/hash/row, zero denominator, wrong n, malformed ID, duplicate, unexpected case/layer/j/K/budget, target access before candidate freeze, or scorer exception is FAIL. Exact comparisons are unrounded.
fixed_scorer_specification.reported_only: Report precision, full-union coverage, event-weighted recall, candidate elapsed time, NextN expert work, router work, and raw byte counters, but none can grant PASS in this accuracy-only screen.
mutations: wrong post-head-normalized tensor instead of post-residual g->next
candidate access to Phase-B target routes before freeze
delete, duplicate, or reorder layer 3 or any layer
include one train-precision row in frequency fitting
NaN, Inf, zero denominator, digest mismatch, and held-out path

acceptance.pass: Every condition passes and all mutations fail. Proceed only to a new, separately reviewed physical cost/cache/lead-time contract.
acceptance.fail: Preserve the negative accuracy curves and stop this recursive proxy branch.

deferred_cost_gate.required_scope: Bind exact target-expert, layer-78 MTP-expert, 75 router-head, and other tensor offset inventories; deterministic cache snapshots/simulator; logical and physical reads; page faults; staging; QD; address-to-use lead; and total incremental time/bytes against avoided true misses. The fio QD4-8 curve is the storage authority. Prefetch and admission consumers remain separate arms.
deferred_cost_gate.reason: Separating causal accuracy from physical economics prevents an accuracy screen from making a serving claim and avoids building cache/I/O machinery for a predictor that may fail cheaply.

review_resolution.R05-R186-H1-PROXY-RECURRENCE-UNDERSPECIF: Exact z_j tensor boundary, recurrence copy, q indexing, absolute positions, min_pos, and private-KV progression are frozen with wrong-tensor/shift mutations.
review_resolution.R05-R186-H2-OPEN-EVIDENCE-AUTHORITY-UNBO: Engine/model/tokenizer, prompt/index, open split manifests/records, exact cases/request IDs, split isolation, and future scorer freeze rule are hash-bound.
review_resolution.R05-R186-H3-LATENCY-BYTE-PHYSICS-INCOMPL: No physical-feasibility claim can pass this screen; all cache/byte/lead economics are a mandatory separately preregistered gate after an accuracy PASS.
review_resolution.ADV-R05-R186-H1-UNSEALED-TOKEN-BRANCH-AL: Candidate and verifier are separate processes; candidate token/position records freeze before verifier evaluates exactly that branch; retained target routes are prohibited.
review_resolution.ADV-R05-R186-H2-ZERO-DELTA-BASELINE-CLON: Both paired lower bounds must exceed baselines by at least 0.03 and baseline-clone mutations must fail.
review_resolution.ADV-R05-R186-H3-INCOMPLETE-CAUSAL-BYTE-A: Online/cache claims are removed; the mandatory follow-on cost gate is explicitly specified and cannot be skipped.
review_resolution.ADV-R05-R186-H4-SELECTABLE-FIVE-CASE-SCO: The exact five-case t statistic, critical value, zero-variance/no-clipping rules, schemas, tie ordering, hashes, and mutations are fixed.
review_resolution.ADV-R05-R186-M1-AGGREGATE-QUALITY-CAN-HI: Every one of the 75 layers must have point recall at least 0.50.

convergence.escalation_rule: Pause if round 187 is a second consecutive candidate without strict blocking-set shrinkage, if a new critical requires changing frozen scope, or if this gate exceeds eight candidates.
